name: s3-lab-workspace
description: Search S3 research memory and build restrained, English, figure-first lab-meeting slides.

interface.shortDescription: Research memory and figure-first lab slides
interface.longDescription: Search and extend the lab's shared S3 Research Memory, then turn research progress into restrained, editable PowerPoint decks with English keyword titles, a closed lab palette, and dominant research figures. The plugin connects directly to the central HTTPS MCP service and does not depend on a personal app ID.
defaultPrompt: Find relevant S3 research lessons, then outline this week's English lab-meeting deck.
Build a restrained editable deck with keyword titles and one dominant figure per body slide.
Save this evidence-backed lesson to S3 Research Memory.
